question: Where should the twelfth kalā Ghorarūpā be ritually placed on the practitioner’s body?
premises: The twelfth kalā is named Ghorarūpā.
The specified location is the right shoulder.
inference: One should place the twelfth kalā Ghorarūpā in the right shoulder.
plain_english: One should place the twelfth kalā, Ghorarūpā, in the right shoulder.
